title: One-row toroidal sandpiles
target: For every positive n, is the common serial toppling count T(n,1) equal to A023855(n) at the printed offset?

title: CHSH theta series
target: Does the series with A210066 coefficients at exp(−π) converge to (2+√2)/4?

title: Hydrogen wavelength recurrence
target: Do the three listed formulae hold for all positive levels (recurrence for n>5) under the listed rounding convention? Test both the source program and any scale compatible with its tabulated measurements.

title: Hydrogen wavelength differences
target: Do the three listed formulae hold for all forward wavelength differences (recurrence for n>4)? Linked to the same rounding obstruction as A145646.

title: Six-vertex quantum graphs
target: For every D≥3, can any complex weighting realize the six-vertex monochromatic matching equation system? Track the reduction only and credit the existing results.

title: A sheared Floquet discriminant
target: For even continuous periodic potentials, can the half-trace have a stationary point in the open band? Track real and complex potentials separately.
